output.sql:
SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
output.explanation: Sums net revenue per customer segment for orders dated in calendar year 2025, counting only orders flagged as revenue (is_revenue). "Revenue" is taken to mean net_revenue, and segments are listed from highest to lowest.
